Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed in the very first step that Frank Tuttle died in 1963. While the WebSurfer had not yet provided the death date for Frank Tuttle, the Planner included this specific year in the "Updated Understanding" section before any verification was performed. This premature assumption led to the subsequent logic flow where the comparison was based on an unverified fact, even though the final conclusion happened to be correct due to the actual death dates. The error lies in hallucinating or inferring data (Tuttle's death year) without first gathering it through the available tools.
